modelingNotes: Exact order number 1212400000 is HDC 24B ABU, installation size 8, standard bulkhead housing, lower part without cover and without cable entries. The side-locking clamp is on the lower side and is not replaceable. GTIN 4008190083939. Source: manufacturer datasheet pp.1–3; RockStar catalogue 2721750000, D.28 (physical PDF p.250) distinguishes this order from the N variant.

The current datasheet documents die-cast aluminium with powder coating, stainless-steel locking elements and NBR sealing. IP65 is expressly in the plugged condition; the manufacturer also instructs that the flat gasket be correctly seated when mounting. These are component/assembly conditions, not an assertion about any installation.

This proposal contains no electrical terminals, functions or fixed links. The product image, dimension drawing and exact catalogue row do not identify a bonding terminal or prove an electrical path through the panel, insert, housing, locking clamp or mounting hardware. Absence of such detail is not proof that the physical bonding-interface inventory is empty; connection coverage remains partial.

HOUSING is metadata for the mechanical mounting/mating interface only. Contact inserts and mating parts are separate items; no insert pins or PE contacts are assigned to this housing and no electrical mating continuity is authored.

The exact manufacturer datasheet was obtained successfully over normal TLS on 2026-09-11, replacing the earlier access limitation. Its p.2 limit temperature is -40 °C to 125 °C. No voltage or current capability is authored. Current and historical dimension values are not combined into an asserted installation drawing.
